verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਪਇਆਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro dharat akaas ula(n)gh piaanaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh goes beyond air, water, fire, earth and sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਲੰਘਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਹਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaam krodh virodh la(n)gh lobh moh aha(n)kaar vihaanaa|

en.bdb: Resisting lust and anger he crosses the greed, infatuation and ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸੁ ਗਰੰਥੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arathu su gara(n)th pa(n)ch paravaanaa|

en.bdb: He espouses truth, contentment, compassion, dharma and fortitude.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਚਾਚਰੀ ਉਨਮਨ ਲੰਘਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: khechar bhoochar chaacharee unaman la(n)gh agochar baanaa|

en.bdb: Getting above of the khechar bhuchar chachar, unman and agochar (all yogic postures) mudras  he concentrates upon the One Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਘਨਘੋਰ ਨੀਸਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)chain paramesaro pa(n)ch sabadh ghanaghor neesaanaa|

en.bdb: He beholds God in five (select persons) and the five sounds of five words become his special marks.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਆਤਮਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਹਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)ch bhooaatamaa saadhasa(n)gat mil saadh suhaanaa|

en.bdb: Antahkaran, the basis of all five external elements is cultivated and cultured by the gurmukh in the holy congregation.
This way immersing in undisturbed trance he gets liberated from the cycle of transmigration.
